svg.title: Project Proposal — project-name
svg.desc: Reference reconstruction of user-supplied IMG_8173.PNG panel 4. Live editable text and native vector geometry. Original typefaces unidentified; Inter 400/900 used as licensed substitutes. Photographs are cropped only from their regions in the supplied image. Unreadable miniature placeholder prose is an approximation of its density, not a verified transcription.
svg.text: Sum eart om niam es suo. Agnimus sinius invel-
lam eicium nusdantium eosam letum covest vend
accuut. Nius offictorum occae mo qui mlicium iture
neclio. Omnimor iant. Bovids ten, quas eal quias,
Acis et dolent explid ut venis
